Disappointed
Aug 2026 • Couples
I was very disappointed with this restaurant. The reviews were good, so we decided to give it a try, but our experience was terrible.

We waited for our food for over an hour. After 30 minutes, the staff finally came back and told us that the pho we had ordered was unavailable. We chose different dishes instead, but even after that, we continued waiting. In total, more than an hour passed, and we still hadn’t received our food.

The service was extremely slow, and there was very little communication from the staff. Unfortunately, this was a very frustrating experience, and I can’t recommend this restaurant.
